title: Codex /review-code child aborts with "Review resource limit prevented completion" on a 55-path committed input
outcome: A reviewer that cannot cover a large committed input says so before it starts, or the host offers a supported way (such as an automatic path-family split with a coverage ledger) to complete whole coverage, so whole-diff reviews no longer end partial.
acceptance: The cause of the abort for Codex session-17937 (delegation-6723fef7-f6bd-4cfb-a0d2-26e48f291df5) is identified and recorded: either a model context or budget limit of the reviewer, or a host-side defect in the review resource accounting.
If it is a host defect, it is fixed, and a regression test shows a reviewer over an input of comparable size completing or refusing with a clear, documented reason before review begins.

If it is an expected model budget, the supported procedure for whole-coverage review of large inputs is documented (in the /review-changes command or docs/features), including how coverage across split sessions is evidenced.
